copy.description: A minimalist graphic featuring a solid teal circle beside a mustard-yellow rectangle with a white circle cutout, paired with bold pixel-style text reading 'WILD BLOOM'. Clean geometric shapes and a retro typographic treatment give this design a playful, nature-inspired feel suitable for apparel, packaging, or decor accents.
copy.altText: Teal circle and mustard rectangle with white circle cutout above pixel-style text reading WILD BLOOM.
copy.caption: Wild Bloom - bold shapes, retro pixel type.
